record_operation: Performed present-day source curation and target assignment; no physical experiment performed for this record.
candidate_scope: A proposed verification of the source-described PIC 1/linker 2a system, described using a two-monomer feed basis. Input feed, isolated polymer and wet gel are separate material stages.

composition.basis: Monomer mole/number fraction of the nominal two-monomer charge, excluding every other process input.
composition.material_stage: Feed targets selected for this record, before polymerization; not retained polymer or wet-gel composition.
composition.normalization: Positive target fractions sum exactly to one on this explicitly limited feed denominator.
composition.qualification: Exact arithmetic does not increase source charge precision. The paper need not have printed these exact fractions; this assignment is made in the present record. These are not elemental atomic/mass fractions, measured incorporation or a complete specimen inventory.

source_connectivity.statement: The two source graphs have different methoxy/azide tails. The retained description prints their condensed connectivity.

neutral_formula_accounting.qualification: Calculated graph atom counts, not elemental assays or resolved stereochemical identities.

candidate_identity.statement: No resolved exact stereochemical input, supplier specification, candidate-product sequence or complete molecular-weight distribution is established for this record. The source drawing/name conflict is retained.

source_product_context.material_stage: Published isolated PIC and gel, not the two-monomer feed
source_product_context.statement: The source describes helical PIC and bundled networks, states azide comonomer content and reports a viscometric Mv estimate. Those statements do not prove the assigned feed fractions are incorporated exactly or specify every chain.

source_operations.material_stage: Source monomer-to-PIC preparation and separate PIC-to-gel assembly
source_operations.locator: Supplementary Methods page 1; Sec12/p[1]; preparation-edition D[0065] operation paragraphs
source_operations.statement: Published polymerization, isolation and cold stock mixing followed by heating are retained as attributed operations. Linker 2a stock uses DMSO.

candidate_verification.statement: Resolve input identities and route applicability before reproducing a defined preparation; retain actual quantities, stock-delivery volumes, isolation and thermal history. No preparation has been performed for this record.

candidate_success.statement: No candidate product, yield, retained impurity inventory or successful source-specific repetition is asserted. A feed target does not fill these fields.

candidate_measurement.material_stage: Any new feed, isolated polymer or gel specimen
candidate_measurement.statement: No assay, spectrum, molecular-weight distribution, bridge count or modulus measurement is supplied for a new specimen.

source_gel_context.material_stage: Published PIC 1/linker 2a gels; not measurements of the two-monomer feed
source_gel_context.conditions: Final PIC 1 concentration 1 mg/mL; crosslinking 37 deg C followed by 11 hours at 5 deg C; 40 mm sandblasted parallel plates, 500 micrometre gap, amplitude 0.04 and 1 Hz.
source_gel_context.qualification: Figure 4 reports SD with n = 2 or 3; the absolute table lacks per-row uncertainty. Supplementary page 3 UV-vis error at least 10% concerns conversion/background correction, not rheological uncertainty.

verification_tests.statement: For a future defined specimen, separately determine feed delivery, incorporation and residual inventory; compare oscillatory modulus and corrected conversion data. Record uncertainty, sampling and actual solvent fraction rather than equating conversion with active bridges.

candidate_result.material_stage: New candidate gel; the monomer feed has no assigned gel modulus
candidate_result.statement: No new candidate response, exact stiffness, statistical significance or unexpected result is asserted.

source_gel_context.locator: Supplementary Table 1 page 4; retained property table
source_gel_context.qualification: Different loading comparisons, not opposite outcomes for one specimen under identical conditions. The high-loading listed value remains above the zero-linker control. These are not measurements of the monomer feed or guaranteed candidate results.

bridge_interpretation.statement: The source estimates active bridges from conversion and the two-reactions-on-one-linker assumption. This model is not a direct bridge count; its conversion evidence retains the UV-vis limitation. No new numerical bridge estimate is made.

unsupported_extension.statement: Exact final incorporated fractions 790/817 and 27/817 inferred solely from the nominal feed remain an unsupported possibility, not a physical result. The same feed can lead to different architectures and properties.

property_scenario.temporal_status: Present-day unperformed verification plan informed by already-published comparisons; not an applicant prediction predating those results.
property_scenario.baseline_material_and_state: A future defined PIC 1/linker 2a gel at nominal DBCO/azide 0.1, final PIC concentration 1 mg/mL, assessed at 5 deg C after the specified 37 deg C crosslinking and 11-hour stabilization. This is a proposed specimen, not the source's measured specimen.
property_scenario.controlled_change: Compare nominal DBCO/azide 1.25 with 0.1, holding resolved material identities, polymer batch, final PIC concentration, geometry and thermal schedule fixed; measure and match DMSO fraction. Matching is proposed and not claimed as a source-performed correction.
property_scenario.proposed_response: Hypothesis: higher Gprime at 5 deg C if additional effective intrabundle intermolecular bridges stabilize the network. No magnitude or significance is promised.
property_scenario.mechanism: Conditionally increased active connectivity; the source's bridge interpretation motivates the hypothesis without establishing the candidate's bridge count.
property_scenario.conditions: Use the source-context oscillatory settings as proposed settings, record actual implementation and wait for identity/applicability prerequisites. Related source comparisons are already known.
property_scenario.discriminating_test: Compare matched-solvent rheometry with corrected DBCO conversion and network/retained-material characterization. Determine whether added conversion yields additional elastically effective connectivity; report uncertainty and negative outcomes.

credible_alternative.hypothesis: Unchanged within measurement resolution, or lower Gprime, if the extra nominal dose fails to add effective bridges or reduces active connectivity.
credible_alternative.mechanism: A smaller accessible azide population could make the nominal dose effectively excessive and favor one-ended attachment; proposed candidate accessibility and attachment distributions remain unmeasured.
credible_alternative.scope: A separate conditional hypothesis with a different reaction state, not an assertion of opposing outcomes for the same specimen in identical conditions. This does not reclassify the source's performed comparisons as unperformed.

publication_boundary: This new curation and its exact target assignment are not attributed backward to 2018 or presumed included in an earlier PDF/application. Critical dates and statutory effects remain unresolved.
